verdict: REVIEWED EXCEPTION LIST -- 8 RB3E<->Deluxe general-patch collisions, all with written rulings; same-instrument feature surface is COLLISION-FREE (clean). The TU5 DLL is the RB3DX DLL for the same-instrument feature; general-patch overlaps are benign-idempotent (5) or RB3E-wins-by-design (3).

ruling.reason: RB3E POKE_32(BLR)=0x4e800020 == RB3DX entry word. RB3DX statically bundled this same early-return (Deluxe rewrote the prologue further, but the entry blr is identical and returns before RB3DX's trailing bytes; RB3E only writes the entry word). RB3E-wins is a no-op.
RB3E POKE_32(NOP)=0x60000000 == RB3DX bytes. Deluxe already nop'd the fast-start wait. Idempotent.
RB3E POKE_32(LI(3,0))=0x38600000 == RB3DX bytes. Deluxe already stubbed the song-blacklist check to li r3,0. Idempotent.

RB3E POKE_32(NOP)=0x60000000 == RB3DX bytes; and RB3E only applies it under RB3E_IsEmulator() so on RGH hardware RB3DX's static nop stands untouched. Idempotent either way. (This is the bne->nop site the SI-only divergence study called out at 0x82575f9c.)
RB3E POKE_BL(->PORT_MULTIPLAYER_FIX 0x8282b238)=0x4bd449b9 == RB3DX bytes. Deluxe bundled the identical online-MP crash-fix redirect. Idempotent.

DIVERGENT: RB3E DllMain POKE_BL(App::Run->RunWithoutDebugging)=0x4bffd1f1; RB3DX static=0x4280d1f1 (Deluxe's own redirect at the main() call site). RB3E-wins: DllMain runs at PROCESS_ATTACH, before App::Run executes, so RB3E's RunWithoutDebugging redirect is the final value. RB3DX is designed to run WITH the RB3E DLL loaded, so this supersession is expected, not a regression. Not same-instrument-related. Confirm at Phase-5 boot.

DIVERGENT: RB3E POKE_B(->XeKeysSetKeyHook, a DLL fn) writes a full branch over the import thunk; RB3DX edited only the thunk's low-16 (0x0242->0x0159, a different import RVA/ordinal in Deluxe's XEX import table). RB3E fully redirects XeKeysSetKey to its XeCrypt path, so the underlying import target is mooted. Import-stub/crypto only; not gameplay, not same-instrument.

DIVERGENT: same as PORT_XEKEYSSETKEY_STUB -- RB3E POKE_B over the import thunk redirects XeKeysAesCbc to XeCrypt; RB3DX's low-16 thunk edit (0x024b->0x015b) is mooted by the full RB3E redirect. Crypto import stub.
